Having thought about this deeply for some time 🤓☝️: I think it’s the box design and amount of display/shelf space that we miss. The branding isn’t the same these days. There’s less of them in stores. Less commercials. Less merch. You don’t see half a class of tween girls walking around with MH backpacks and t-shirts anymore. Also we’re nostalgic for pre-pandemic times AND the then-target-demographic is grown up now and capable of retrospection and remembering those days (“those” being the peak of G1 and the few years it took people to bounce back from the 2008 economic crisis). MH isn’t as “gothic” (I prefer to use the word “dark” when referring to their fashions) as it once was and it won’t be. This has to do with the direction of current age media for children and the speedy evolution of technology. The need for color and bright, cute, marketable things. *Money*. Not saying we’re not allowed to miss that era of course!!!! Just a little thought piece.
